accounting.mass_basis: One kg nominal feed on Figure4 reported-yield basis; exact wet/dry normalization not independently established. No renormalization.
accounting.interpretation: Element retained in the measured bio-oil fraction only; remainder is aggregate unassigned feed element, not a gas or char composition. Aqueous fraction is not assumed pure water. Oxygen-by-difference is not treated as an independent measurement.

settings.relation_to_cedrone2024: Feed nominal values/printed spreads match the existing source pool; matching tables do not establish identical aliquots or full experimental batch identity. This package uses the ENEA report itself; it is not transferred to MIA3.

oil_LHV_MJ_kg.classification: reported range across oils; not per-temperature value or measurement uncertainty
oil_LHV_MJ_kg.use: Only oil lower-heating-value content. Not pyrolysis heat or comparison with feed HHV.
